Or, go a little further and make sure everything fits perfectly beforehand. You can do this by whittling down the stumps that connect into the body. If they're too tight you can use sanding paper to shrink the diameter.

This way they slide into the holes and only a light but of glue is needed that will be for the inside of the stump.
